context: Designed after seeing the full baseline history. These are exploratory comparisons, not untouched out-of-sample validation.
unchanged: Same gold quotes, costs, financing, starting capital, entry, grid spacing and net profit target as the baseline.

controls.max_entries: Maximum total purchases per basket, including the initial purchase; zero means unlimited.
controls.max_notional_multiple: Approve new purchases only when total ask notional after the purchase is at most this multiple of basket-start cash. This is an admission limit, not continuous rebalancing.
controls.batch_loss_fraction: Close the basket when its liquidation value after fees falls this fraction below basket-start cash. Gaps and financing can exceed the threshold.
controls.cooldown_hours: After a batch-loss exit, wait this many calendar hours before a new basket. After profit exits, use the original next-minute entry.
controls.account_drawdown_fraction: Close all positions and permanently stop this account at this drawdown from its prior net-equity high. No replenishment or restart.

comparison: Every variant on doubling and fixed-size grids, from 2019 and a fresh 2022 account, on both assumed intraminute paths.
evaluation: Report all results, actual drawdowns, open losses, stops, margin exits and costs. Compare with baseline and SPY/gold. Do not recommend the highest-return historical row without independent evidence.
